title: Crüger to Müller, Easter Monday 1631
author: Peter Crüger
summary: Crüger mourns Kepler, regretting the unfinished works he had promised, and declines to write a funeral poem.

notes.note: Kepler's planned *Hipparchus*, on the sizes and distances of the sun, moon and earth, never finished.
After Plautus, *Asinaria* 202: “our hands always have eyes; they believe what they see.”
